mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months signals economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 0.5% declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) in the prior month signal broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in prior month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a 0.1 percentage point decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals central bank response to inflation, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1pp in prior month over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) level above 100 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through near-term economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is above 100 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 500 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through reduced residential investment and associated economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 500.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 0.5% decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and 0.3 percentage point rise in unemployment (UNRATE) in the prior month signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through reduced consumer confidence and spending.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in prior month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% YoY), a GDP growth slowdown (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% YoY) signals economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through earnings revision expectations.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% YoY), SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% YoY over any 3-year rolling window.
